ei.subject: 6월 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: 35번 — Benefits of Digital Minimalism for Health

fullPassage: It is evident through various case studies that adopting digital minimalism can lead to improved mental health outcomes. For instance, a study conducted by researchers at Stanford University found that participants who limited their use of social media and digital devices reported lower levels of stress, anxiety, and depression. By reducing the constant stream of information and notifications, individuals were able to focus more on meaningful interactions and activities that promoted well-being. In another case, a corporate professional struggling with burnout and insomnia implemented digital minimalism techniques, such as setting boundaries for phone usage and practicing mindfulness. As a result, he experienced improved sleep quality, reduced stress levels, and a newfound sense of calm and clarity.

questions.passage: It is ①<u>evident</u> through various case studies that adopting digital minimalism can lead to improved mental health outcomes. For instance, a study ②<u>conducting</u> by researchers at Stanford University found that participants who limited their use of social media and digital devices ③<u>reported</u> lower levels of stress, anxiety, and depression. By reducing the constant stream of information and notifications, individuals were able to focus more on meaningful interactions and activities that promoted well-being. In another case, a corporate professional struggling with burnout and insomnia implemented digital minimalism techniques, such as setting boundaries for phone usage and ④<u>practicing</u> mindfulness. As a result, he experienced improved sleep quality, reduced stress levels, and a newfound sense of calm and clarity.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② conducting → conducted. 과거분사가 a study를 수식하는 구조이므로 과거분사 conducted가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① evident: It is evident that ~ 보어 형용사 적절
❌ ② conducting: a study conducted by ~ 과거분사 수동 수식 필요 ←정답
✅ ③ reported: 과거형 본동사 적절
✅ ④ practicing: such as setting ... and practicing — 동명사 병렬 적절
det.tip: a study conducted by(수행된) — 과거분사의 수동 수식

questions.passage: It is evident through various case studies that ①<u>adopting</u> digital minimalism can lead to improved mental health outcomes. For instance, a study conducted by researchers at Stanford University found that participants who ②<u>limited</u> their use of social media and digital devices reported lower levels of stress, anxiety, and depression. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ struggled → struggling. 현재분사가 a corporate professional을 수식하는 구조이므로 struggling이 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① adopting: that adopting ~ can lead to — 동명사 주어 적절
✅ ② limited: who limited — 과거형 본동사 적절
✅ ③ meaningful: 형용사 적절
❌ ④ struggled: a professional struggling with — 능동 현재분사 수식 필요 ←정답
det.tip: a professional struggling with(~와 씨름하는) — 현재분사의 능동 수식

questions.passage: It is evident through various case studies that adopting digital minimalism ①<u>cans</u> lead to improved mental health outcomes. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① cans → can. 조동사 can은 동사원형 앞에서 형태 변화 없이 사용된다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① cans: 조동사 can은 3인칭 단수에서도 변형 없음 → can ←정답
✅ ② lower: 비교급 형용사 적절
✅ ③ were able to: 과거형 be able to 적절
✅ ④ experienced: 과거형 본동사 적절
det.tip: 조동사(can/will/must 등)는 주어에 관계없이 형태 변화 없음

questions.passage: It is evident through various case studies ①<u>that</u> adopting digital minimalism can lead to improved mental health outcomes. For instance, a study conducted by researchers at Stanford University found that participants ②<u>who</u> limited their use of social media and digital devices reported lower levels of stress, anxiety, and depression. By reducing the constant stream of information and notifications, individuals were able to focus more on meaningful interactions and activities ③<u>what promoted</u> well-being. In another case, a corporate professional struggling with burnout and insomnia implemented digital minimalism techniques, such as ④<u>setting</u> boundaries for phone usage and practicing mindfulness. As a result, he experienced improved sleep quality, reduced stress levels, and a newfound sense of calm and clarity.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ what promoted → that promoted. 선행사 activities가 있으므로 관계대명사 that이 적절하다. what은 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사로 여기서 사용 불가.
det.analysis:
✅ ① that: It is evident that ~ 접속사 적절
✅ ② who: participants who limited — 관계대명사 적절
❌ ③ what promoted: 선행사 activities 있음 → that/which 필요 ←정답
✅ ④ setting: such as setting boundaries — 동명사 적절
det.tip: 선행사 있으면 that/which, 선행사 없으면 what

questions.passage: It is evident through various case studies that ①<u>adopting</u> digital minimalism can lead to improved mental health outcomes. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ drift(방황하다)는 원문 focus(집중하다)와 반대 의미. 정보를 줄이면 의미 있는 활동에 '집중'할 수 있다는 맥락.
det.analysis:
✅ ① adopting: 원문 일치 — 채택하는
✅ ② lower: 원문 일치 — 더 낮은
❌ ③ drift: 원문 focus(집중하다) → drift(방황하다, 표류하다)는 반의어 ←정답
✅ ④ struggling: 원문 일치 — 힘겹게 씨름하는
det.tip: focus(집중하다) ↔ drift(방황하다, 주의가 흩어지다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① stem from(~에서 비롯되다)는 원문 lead to(~로 이어지다)와 반대 의미. 디지털 미니멀리즘이 정신 건강 개선으로 '이어진다'는 맥락.
det.analysis:
❌ ① stem from: 원문 lead to(~로 이어지다) → stem from(~에서 비롯되다)는 반의어 ←정답
✅ ② reported: 원문 일치 — 보고했다
✅ ③ promoted: 원문 일치 — 촉진했다
✅ ④ calm: 원문 일치 — 평온함
det.tip: lead to(~로 이어지다) ↔ stem from(~에서 비롯되다)

det.korean: T — 원문: a study conducted by researchers at Stanford University found that participants who limited their use of social media...

det.korean: F — 원문: a corporate professional struggling with burnout and insomnia. 이미 번아웃과 불면증으로 힘들어하고 있었다.
det.analysis: ✅ F: 원문과 반대 — 번아웃이 없었던 것이 아니라 이미 겪고 있었음

det.korean: T — 원문: implemented digital minimalism techniques, such as setting boundaries for phone usage and practicing mindfulness.
det.analysis: ✅ T: 원문과 일치 — setting boundaries for phone usage가 디지털 미니멀리즘 기법의 예시로 언급됨
det.tip: such as = ~와 같은 (예시 열거)

questions.passage: It is evident through various case studies that adopting digital minimalism can lead to improved mental health outcomes. For instance, a study conducted by researchers at Stanford University found that participants who limited their use of social media and digital devices reported lower levels of stress, anxiety, and depression. By reducing the constant stream of information and notifications, individuals were able to focus more on meaningful interactions and activities that promoted well-being. In another case, a corporate professional struggling with burnout and insomnia implemented digital minimalism techniques, such as __________ for phone usage and practicing mindfulness. As a result, he experienced improved sleep quality, reduced stress levels, and a newfound sense of calm and clarity.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 디지털 미니멀리즘 기법으로, 전화 사용에 대한 경계를 설정하는 것(setting boundaries)이 언급되었다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① avoiding interaction(상호작용 회피): 본문은 meaningful interactions에 집중하라고 함
❌ ② deleting applications(앱 삭제): 본문에 언급 없음
✅ ③ setting boundaries: 전화 사용에 대한 경계 설정 — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ monitoring progress(진행 모니터링): 본문에 언급 없음
det.tip: setting boundaries = 경계/한계를 설정하다

questions.passage: It is evident through various case studies that adopting digital minimalism can lead to improved mental health outcomes. For instance, a study conducted by researchers at Stanford University found that participants who limited their use of social media and digital devices reported lower levels of stress, anxiety, and depression. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 정보와 알림의 흐름을 줄임으로써 의미 있는 상호작용과 활동(meaningful interactions and activities)에 더 집중할 수 있었다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① digital devices and social media: 줄여야 할 대상이지 집중할 대상 아님
✅ ② meaningful interactions and activities: focus more on ~ that promoted well-being ←정답
❌ ③ stress levels and depression: 줄어든 부정적 결과
❌ ④ burnout and insomnia: 해결해야 할 문제이지 집중할 대상 아님
det.tip: meaningful interactions = 의미 있는 상호작용. 정보 과부하를 줄이면 집중할 수 있는 대상.

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ④ 원문: participants who limited their use ... reported lower levels of stress.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 부정적 영향: 원문 improved — 긍정적 영향
❌ ② 사용 늘림: 원문 limited — 사용 제한
❌ ③ 수면 질 저하: 원문 improved sleep quality — 수면 질 향상
✅ ④ 스트레스 낮아짐: 원문 일치 ←정답
det.tip: lower levels of stress = 더 낮은 스트레스 수준

ch: 디지털 미니멀리즘은 정신 건강에 부정적인 영향을 준다.
스탠포드 연구 참가자들은 소셜 미디어 사용을 늘렸다.
회사원은 수면의 질이 저하되는 결과를 경험했다.
디지털 기기 사용을 줄인 참가자들은 스트레스 수준이 낮아졌다.

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ① 원문: practicing mindfulness(마음챙김). 명상(meditation)이 아닌 마음챙김을 실천했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 명상을 실천: 원문 mindfulness(마음챙김) → 명상(meditation)이 아님 ←정답
✅ ② 사용 제한 참가자: 원문 일치
✅ ③ 사례 통해 입증: 원문 일치 — various case studies
✅ ④ 평온함과 명료함: 원문 일치 — a newfound sense of calm and clarity
det.tip: mindfulness(마음챙김) ≠ meditation(명상). 유사하지만 다른 개념.

ch: 소셜 미디어와 디지털 기기 사용을 제한한 참가자들이 연구에 포함되었다.
디지털 미니멀리즘의 효과는 다양한 사례를 통해 입증되었다.
그 회사원은 결과적으로 평온함과 명료함을 새롭게 얻었다.

questions.passage: It is evident through various case studies that adopting digital minimalism can lead to ①<u>improved</u> mental health outcomes. questions.stem: 다음 글에서 원문과 다르게 쓰인 부분을 고르시오.

det.korean: ③ prevented(방지한) → 원문 promoted(촉진한). 의미 있는 활동이 안녕을 '촉진'한 것이지 '방지'한 것이 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① improved: 원문 일치
✅ ② depression: 원문 일치
❌ ③ prevented: 원문 promoted(촉진한) → prevented(방지한)는 다른 의미 ←정답
✅ ④ insomnia: 원문 일치
det.tip: promoted(촉진한) ≠ prevented(방지한). 방향이 완전히 다름.

det.tip: social media = 소셜 미디어, digital devices = 디지털 기기

questions.passage: It is evident through various case studies that adopting digital minimalism can lead to improved mental health outcomes. For instance, a study conducted by researchers at Stanford University found that participants who limited their use of social media and digital devices reported lower levels of stress, anxiety, and depression. By reducing the constant stream of information and notifications, individuals were able to focus more on meaningful interactions and activities that promoted well-being. In another case, a corporate professional struggling with burnout and insomnia implemented digital minimalism techniques, such as setting boundaries for phone usage and practicing mindfulness. As a result, he experienced improved sleep quality, reduced stress levels, and a newfound sense of calm and clarity.
